proposal.rationale: Several undetermined sections in Title 37's umbrella (Chapter 1) are clearly title-wide in scope but use Louisiana-specific phrasings rather than the generic "this Title applies to" formula. Refinements: (1) §37:23 — "Each board or commission authorized to issue a license, permit, or certificate under this Title" — title-wide. (2) §37:23.1 — "Any board or commission created and provided for within this Title" — title-wide. (3) §37:23.2 — "Each state entity subject to the provisions of this Title" — title-wide. (4) §37:23.3 and §37:21 — apply to "professional or occupational [licensing] board or commission" generally (no special law applicable), which in the context of Title 37 means all licensing boards under the title. (5) §37:33 and §37:34 — apply to any "entity issuing licenses to engage in certain fields of work pursuant to state law," a Louisiana-specific universal phrase covering all licensing entities. §37:1 (mere definitions of Department/Director) and §37:6 (enumerating specific merged boards) and §37:24 (specific listed professions) remain non-universal and will stay undetermined, which is correct.
